items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Experience with CADS CRM to conduct research, process acknowledgements, perform donor analysis, and prepare stewardship materials.

25%  Administrative and Executive Support: Manages the development calendar, schedules donor visits, and tracks development activities. Works with CADS and with UDAR colleagues on contact reports, gift and pledge agreements, and gift fulfillment. Processes reimbursement expenses incurred related to CITRIS fundraising activities. Provides administrative support to the Senior Director of Development, including scheduling and managing key meetings involving CITRIS and campus leaders.

20%  Stewardship: Manages donor stewardship, produces and tracks acknowledgements, and customizes stewardship reports for donors. Creates bespoke acknowledgments and VIP donor communications for the CITRIS Director. Tracks and records contacts with key prospects, monitors proposal activity and prospect solicitation strategies, and updates biographical and other prospect information in CADS. Ensures that recorded donor data and gift designations are accurate, up to date, and complete. Works with UDAR to ensure data integrity. Liaises with UDAR Fund management and other UDAR teams across all four CITRIS campuses.

20%  Fundraising Support: Acknowledges and synthesizes knowledge on donors and CITRIS to prepare event briefings and meeting briefings for CITRIS leaders, including the CITRIS Director and Executive Director, the Senior Director of Development, other institute leaders, key faculty, and other campus leadership. Work with the development and communications teams on special stewardship projects, such as holiday cards, CITRIS alumni tracking, and other initiatives. Develop solicitation materials, including slide decks, email, and social media postings, to support fundraising programs. May research alumni, parents, friends, corporations, and foundations to help identify prospects. Participates in the transition to a new CRM system.

20%  Event Planning & VIP Meeting Support: Manages the organization and execution of special events for donors and volunteer leaders, including advisory board and climate advisory council, as well as cultivation and donor stewardship events. Plays a role in supporting major complex events managed by CITRIS.

10%  Event Planning & VIP Meeting Support: Manages the organization and execution of special events for donors and volunteer leaders, including advisory board and climate advisory council, as well as cultivation and donor stewardship events. Plays a role in supporting major complex events managed by CITRIS.
5%    Professional Development: engages in opportunities for training, workshops, seminars, and other professional development activities pertinent to the position.
Able to work successfully in teams and independently; able to shift priorities, manage multiple projects at once, and meet deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, and customer service skills.
Solid knowledge of common University-specific computer application programs, and Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Google Enterprise.
Sound knowledge of fundraising principles, donor relations concepts, and practices.
Knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques.

Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities, including event planning, donor and funder relations and engagement, donor stewardship, and contracts and grants regulations and guidelines.
Excellent organizational and project management skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, effective decision-making and problem-solving, and adaptability to changing circumstances.
Knowledge of the campus and CITRIS, and its mission, vision, goals, objectives, achievements, activities, and infrastructure.
Professional integrity, discretion, sound judgment, and the ability to handle very confidential information.
